:::{.analytics-intro}
# Site Analytics

This dashboard tracks real-time visitor activity on my portfolio site using Google Analytics 4 and Data Studio (formerly called Looker Studio). Setting it up involved configuring a GA4 property and data stream, embedding a tracking tag directly into my Quarto site, and designing a custom Looker Studio report to visualize the data. The dashboard updates automatically and tracks key metrics including page views, session duration, traffic sources, device types, and visitor locations worldwide
:::
